name: @animastor/url-safety
description: Animastor URL Safety — the SSRF guard of the Animastor backend, physically extracted from the host: public-endpoint assertion (http/https only, literal loopback/private/link-local/metadata IPv4+IPv6 incl. decimal/octal/hex alternative forms and IPv4-mapped IPv6, ALL-records DNS resolution against private/special ranges, fail-closed on resolution errors) and safeFetch with per-hop re-validation and manual redirect following. The package reaches the host ONLY through the injected dnsResolver/fetchImpl ports (runtime defaults: node:dns + global.fetch, resolved at call time) — no process.env, no backend config, no Express, no filesystem inside; the operator-exemption (validatePublic=false) is an explicit call parameter, never an env read.
